title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2610.31511v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations \rev{through separate per-player decision calls}, selecting high-level actions \rev{and image-labeled target cells} while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of \rev{two-player} coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. translated_title: DuoCook：一个受Overcooked启发的视觉规划与协作基准测试
translated_abstract: 在烹饪任务中协调两名玩家，要求视觉-语言智能体能够跟踪不断变化的场景状态、按顺序安排食谱步骤，并在时间预算内合理分配共享资源。我们提出了一个受Overcooked启发的基准测试，在使用编码智能体构建的虚幻引擎环境中评估这些能力。单个视觉-语言模型通过针对每个玩家的独立决策调用，基于俯视视觉观察来控制两名玩家，选择高层动作和以图像标注的目标格子，而引擎负责执行导航。该基准测试包含五个类别共20张地图，这些类别支持在设备竞争、地形变化和交接依赖条件下评估双人协作能力。道具图例和锅中食材数量指示器提供明确的视觉线索，基于网格的目的地支持空间定位；文本中不提供工位坐标，因此目标定位必须依赖视觉信息。
tldr: 该论文提出了DuoCook，一个基于虚幻引擎、受Overcooked启发的视觉规划与协作基准测试，通过20张五种类别的地图，评估视觉-语言模型在双人烹饪任务中跟踪场景变化、规划食谱步骤和分配共享资源的协调能力。
en_tdlr: DuoCook is an Overcooked-inspired benchmark built in Unreal Engine that evaluates vision-language models' visual planning and two-player coordination capabilities across 20 maps in five categories, testing equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies.
